name: Digital Agency
description: A digital agency helping local businesses with social media content creation, management, CRM automations, and blog content.
mission: Help local businesses grow their online presence through data-driven content strategy, consistent high-quality content, and smart automation.

canva.description: Visual design — Instagram posts, carousels, stories, Facebook posts, etc.

moda.setupCommand: claude mcp add --transport http moda https://mcp.moda.app
moda.description: AI design tool for editable visual assets and social media graphics.

trello.description: Content pipeline management — cards for each post, workflow stages.

agents.name: Account Director
agents.description: Oversees all client accounts. Plans content calendars, prioritizes work, delegates tasks, reviews deliverables, and compiles weekly client reports.

agents.name: Competitor Analyst
agents.description: Researches competitor social media profiles, identifies trending topics, performs gap analysis, and delivers content opportunity reports for each client.

agents.name: Content Strategist
agents.description: Turns research into structured weekly/monthly content plans with specific post topics, formats, platforms, and scheduling. Creates Trello cards for each post.

agents.name: Content Writer
agents.description: Writes social media post copy, captions, hashtag sets, and content batches adapted to each client's brand voice and target audience.

agents.name: Blog Specialist
agents.description: Writes SEO-optimized blog posts. Handles keyword research, outlines, drafts, and meta descriptions to drive organic traffic for clients.

agents.name: Visual Designer
agents.description: Creates social media visuals using Canva and Moda. Generates Instagram posts, carousels, stories, Facebook graphics, and other visual assets on-brand.

agents.name: Fact Checker
agents.description: Verifies all claims, statistics, and factual information in content before publishing. Flags unsubstantiated claims and suggests corrections.

agents.name: Quality Reviewer
agents.description: Final review of all content and visuals. Checks brand consistency, grammar, tone, SEO, and ensures everything matches the content plan before client delivery.

workflow.description: End-to-end content pipeline from research to published post

stages.name: Plan
stages.output: Weekly content calendar + Trello cards created

routines.name: morning-briefing
routines.description: Account Director reviews all client boards in Trello, checks pipeline status, and assigns daily tasks.

routines.name: competitor-research
routines.description: Competitor Analyst runs weekly research on competitor profiles, trending topics, and content opportunities for all clients.

routines.name: content-planning
routines.description: Content Strategist builds the weekly content plan based on research and creates Trello cards for each post.

routines.name: content-batch
routines.description: Content Writer writes post copy for all cards in the 'Writing' list across client boards.

routines.name: visual-batch
routines.description: Visual Designer creates Canva/Moda graphics for all cards in the 'Visual Design' list.

routines.name: blog-drafts
routines.description: Blog Specialist researches keywords and drafts blog posts for clients on the publishing schedule.

routines.name: fact-check-sweep
routines.description: Fact Checker reviews all content in the 'Fact Check' list for accuracy and compliance.

routines.name: quality-review
routines.description: Quality Reviewer checks all content in the 'Review' list for brand consistency, grammar, and overall quality.

routines.name: weekly-client-report
routines.description: Account Director compiles weekly performance summaries for each client — content published, pipeline status, and next week's plan.
